feeds.title: family budgeting
feeds.description: Family Budgeting is a top UK parenting blog written by Becky Goddard Hill award winning thrifty blogger, It covers all aspects of frugal family life. My blog is full of ideas for living creatively as a family on a budget.

feeds.title: Baby budgeting | simple, thrifty & creative family life
feeds.description: Hi I'm Becky - Welcome to my award winning budgeting blog which is full of creative tips for raising a family on a budget. This site is all about is all about aspects of budgeting for a family. Lots of ideas of ways to make and save money

feeds.title: Savings 4 Savvy Mums
feeds.description: A website for mums who want to save their family money day to day, eat a better range of food for less and make money saving simple; to show that it is possible to achieve your financial goals on a budget.

feeds.title: Skint Dad | Where Every Penny Counts
feeds.description: Skint Dad is the destination online where every penny counts.Whether you're looking to cut back on your food bill, save for a rainy day, or find inventive ways to up your income; Skint Dad has the answer. Save money, make money, manage your money. Resources, tips, tricks and deals for everyone.

feeds.title: The Diary of a Frugal Family | Living a Fabulously Frugal Family Life
feeds.description: The Diary of a Frugal Family is a blog following the Frugal Family's journey to becoming more frugal, having as much fun as possible along the way. The aim is to save money wherever possible so that we can spend it on fun things with the kids.

feeds.title: Mums Savvy Savings
feeds.description: Hi I am Emma, writer, teacher, public speaker and also the editor. Mums Savvy Savings is my new venture. I like the good things things in life, along with the rest of the family and in order to have that I need to be savvy. We are undergoing huge family changes as I swap the classroom for freelacing to give our family more quality time and more attention. Therefore this blog will document how I am saving money but still living the good life.

feeds.title: Saving In London City
feeds.description: Blogger Taryn's mission is to seek out the best money-saving tips and hacks. Read her latest articles sharing best practices for long-term money goals, such as saving for a house deposit, traveling, and investing, whilst also enjoying everything London has to offer.

feeds.title: Bee Money Savvy Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Emma, the one-woman team that created Bee Money Savvy. Using the tricks found on this website you will be able to improve your bank balance by spending less and earning more, all while living a more sustainable lifestyle. Here you will find articles on Personal finance, money saving, extra income, freebies and competitions.

feeds.title: The Frugal Cottage » Budgeting
feeds.description: Features articles on budgeting, investing, and early retirement. The Frugal Cottage assists you with financial freedom and living the good life on a budget.

feeds.title: All That I'm Eating
feeds.description: Hi, I am Caroline Taylor. Welcome to All That I'm Eating. You will find inventive recipes using seasonal and foraged ingredients as well as everyday easy meals and a few indulgent recipes too. This blog offers recipe ideas for budget meals, everyday cooking and a little indulgence.

feeds.title: Utterly Scrummy Food For Families
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Michelle. I am sharing how we eat healthily and heartily on a very tight budget in my blog. Get budget-friendly, easy, tasty food for busy families.

feeds.title: Money Saving Girl
feeds.description: My name is Martyna Sroka-Lalewicz aka Money Saving Girl, I live and work in London.

feeds.title: Budgeting and Planning Blog
feeds.description: Gain clarity, learn how to create & love your own spending plan & feel in control with these tutorials, guides & stories. The Budgeting and Planning Blog is packed with Budgeting Toolkits for First Time Home Buyers, Busy Families, Beginners, Small Businesses, and more. Discover useful articles and resources to help you plan better.
